records.sql:
SELECT CASE 
    WHEN SUBSTR(month, 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '03' THEN 'Q1' 
    WHEN SUBSTR(month, 6, 2) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN 'Q2' 
    WHEN SUBSTR(month, 6, 2) BETWEEN '07' AND '09' THEN 'Q3' 
    ELSE 'Q4' 
END AS quarter, 
SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM ledger
WHERE account_group = 'Revenue' 
  AND month LIKE '2025%'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter;

records.question: Quarterly operating profit in 2026
records.raw:
```json
{"sql": "SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN month BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-03' THEN '2026-Q1' 
        WHEN month BETWEEN '2026-04' AND '2026-06' THEN '2026-Q2' 
        WHEN month BETWEEN '2026-07' AND '2026-09' THEN '2026-Q3' 
    END AS quarter,
    SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Cost of sales' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Operating expense' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS operating_profit
FROM ledger
WHERE month LIKE '2026%'
GROUP BY quarter
HAVING quarter IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY quarter;", "explanation": "The query calculates the operating profit by subtracting both 'Cost of sales' and 'Operating expense' from 'Revenue' for each three-month period in 2026. It uses a CASE statement to group the months into quarters (Q1, Q2, and Q3) and filters for the year 2026."}
```
records.sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN month BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-03' THEN '2026-Q1' 
        WHEN month BETWEEN '2026-04' AND '2026-06' THEN '2026-Q2' 
        WHEN month BETWEEN '2026-07' AND '2026-09' THEN '2026-Q3' 
    END AS quarter,
    SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Revenue' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Cost of sales' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN account_group = 'Operating expense' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS operating_profit
FROM ledger
WHERE month LIKE '2026%'
GROUP BY quarter
HAVING quarter IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY quarter;
records.explanation: The query calculates the operating profit by subtracting both 'Cost of sales' and 'Operating expense' from 'Revenue' for each three-month period in 2026. It uses a CASE statement to group the months into quarters (Q1, Q2, and Q3) and filters for the year 2026.
